summary: Frontend-only regression executed on public preview for homepage hero/audience/services/navigation/contact preselect flows. Most acceptance checks passed, with 2 notable gaps.

ui_bugs.issue: At 1024px viewport, hero photo switches to absolute/background mode instead of full-width stacked photograph below copy. This conflicts with the approved tablet/mobile behavior expectation.
Same-route close flow could not be reliably validated after reopen: menu panel intermittently appears partially off-viewport in automation and nav link click fails with 'outside of viewport'.

action_items: Decide tablet breakpoint behavior: if 1024 should behave as tablet, extend stacked-hero rule to include 1024 width.
Stabilize mobile sheet open state/animation timing so same-route link remains fully clickable after repeated open/close cycles.
Re-run FAQ + reduced-motion regression after mobile-menu stability fix (not fully completed in this run due repeated menu interaction failure).
critical_code_review_comments: Audience pathway links and native client_type preselects are correctly wired (CPA / Accounting Firm, Bookkeeping Firm, Business).
All 4 home service icon links resolve to /services#anchor and targets are visible below sticky header in tested desktop flow.
QuickBooks statement remains consistent between homepage and Services page; no unsupported new services introduced.
No competitor brand/assets detected in frontend runtime content; reference appears only in image credits attribution file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Completed checks: no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920, hero image naturalWidth observed as 900 (mobile source) and 1800 (desktop source), audience preselect links pass, hero/services CTAs pass, service anchor visibility under sticky header passes, contact details + trademark retained. Three attempts were made to validate mobile same-route close; repeated 'outside viewport' failures encountered for mobile-nav-link-services after reopen sequence.
rca of the issue: Likely breakpoint and animation-state causes: (1) CSS uses max-width:1023 for stacked hero, so 1024 falls into desktop branch by design. (2) Mobile sheet interaction appears timing/transform-sensitive during repeated open/close; element exists but can remain outside clickable viewport during animation, causing same-route click failure.
